dropped.name: Synth-Axon-488
dropped.reason: duplicate of channel 3 (Synth-Axon), which has the stronger signal: not written

dropped.name: DAPI
dropped.reason: nuclear stain: written (and the tissue mask), not embedded

dropped.name: Synth-Vessel
dropped.reason: flat over the tissue (p99.5 - background = 0.09): written, not embedded

everythingBright.rule: more than 80% of the marker channels (all written but the nuclear stain) above their 95th percentile over the tissue (folds, bubbles, bright edges); left out of each channel's p99.5

saturatedSquares.rule: more than 50% of the square's pixels at the detector's limit in any written channel

seams.rule: per channel, the sharpest jumps between neighbouring pixel columns / rows and the most common distance between them; a channel shows steps when that distance repeats >= 8 times and the lattice is hit at >= 50% of its positions; flagged when >= 2 channels agree on the spacing (1%) and offset (3 px)

rules.weak: (p99.5 - background) / background < 15: kept in the UMAP, flagged
rules.saturated: more than 1% of the in-tissue pixels at the detector's limit (255 for 8-bit images; 4,095 or 65,535 for 16-bit): kept, flagged
rules.background: 1st percentile of the tissue squares (too little background)
rules.p99_5: 99.5th percentile of (v - background) over the tissue squares, leaving out the everything-bright squares

note: UMAPs, clusters and names are per slide: their colours and positions are not comparable across slides.
